poems.text: Zindagi mein kuch to log mohabbat kar hi lete hain
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Humein maloom hai jannat ki haqeeqat lekin
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Koi aur hota to kya hota
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Ek umr se hun tanhai mein
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Woh jo hum mein tum mein qaraar tha
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Ishq ka matlab hi yeh hai ke aql ka kaam tamaam
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Meri aankhon mein nami hai, is tarha lagta hai
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Dil mein ek lehar si uthi hai
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Mohabbat mein neend udhar jaati hai
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Khuda se dar nahein lagta magar
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Raat din barh rahein hain, hum wahein hain
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Gham itna hai ke ab rona bhi nahi aata
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Yahan kuch log hain jo kuch kaha nahin karte
poems.author: Jaun Elia

poems.text: Mere paas aane ka koi raasta nahi
poems.author: Jaun Elia
